notes.title: #screenshotsaturday - Level 2, more to show
notes.content:
In today's #screenshotsaturday, we are continuing to dive through Level 2, taking you through space!

Here's a preview of another area of the level, going through the meteor field. Of course, they all dance and pulse to the music, as it should.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44617216/98738a66478c1ec3f202ce36f715ccc121ec3fbe.png[/img]

And what's this?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44617216/cf8477932f0432370c13fe08fb24bbf0c89c5312.png[/img]

We'll elaborate on this thing a little later. For now, let's just say it's angry at you.

Until the next one! 

-Phil@Sprytosaur

notes.title: #screenshotsaturday - Level 2 coming up!
notes.content:
Greetings! Thank you for all your patience in getting updates on Amp!

After a long hiatus thru 2024 (because life can hit you with anything!), we are back in full swing since the beginning of the year working on the game.

Today we want to share a little preview of what level 2 is looking like. Without further ado...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44617216/ac9b948951185946a5225d1d82d52288585d6594.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44617216/7d6038bc6989720ab54b7a667c74d76e57711e83.png[/img]

That's right. We're in space! And where are we heading? You will have to wait for another time to find out.

We will start posting our progress on the game right here for you to follow throughout so don't miss out!

-Phil@Sprytosaur
